---
title: Dynamic plots
---

::: {.plot-file id="channel-a"}
src: data/liv_bounds.dat
x: c0
y: c0^2 * c1
label: Channel A ($E^2 \cdot \text{Bound}$)
:::

::: {.plot-function id="theory-scaling"}
expr: 1e-19 * x^2.4
label: Theoretical scaling
:::

::: {.dynamic-plot}
curves: channel-a, theory-scaling
xlabel: $E$ [GeV]
ylabel: Rescaled Bound
xscale: log
yscale: log
:::

::: {.plot-file id="wave-sweep"}
src: data/wave_evolution.dat
x: c0
y: c1..c4
param: 0..3
param-label: $t$ [s]
label: Wave amplitude
:::

::: {.dynamic-plot}
curves: wave-sweep
xlabel: $x$ [m]
ylabel: $\psi(x, t)$
:::
